# Finance committee, 2026-01-22

Monthly meeting of the board finance committee.

- The auditor's draft report is due in March.
- The committee reviewed the revenue effect of ending [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]]: late charges brought in 23,000 dollars in 2025, and collection agency fees took 4,100 dollars of that. The committee will recommend the policy to the board if the budget can absorb the gap.
- Health insurance renewal rises 6 percent.
- The committee meets next on April 16.
